preserved_failures: The first focused fixture attempted to add an already-present resource_requirements member and was corrected without weakening the case.
The first optional-state implementation produced a PowerShell null-array item for absent references and was corrected to an explicit empty array.
The first combined Standard/Deep wrapper used an intentionally insufficient timeout; both tiers were rerun independently to completion.
limitations: This receipt proves workflow contract behavior only.
It does not normalize any project until that project adds its own hash-bound adoption receipt.
It does not add network-interface or any other legacy noun to the current resource registry.
